description: T19 TiDB 8.5 TTL oracles. The manifest pins the metadata-backed warning path (ddl.tidb.ttl.warn), the checkTTLInfoValid refusal boundary (temporary tables, invalid interval, inbound foreign keys, TTL parent restriction), REMOVE TTL silence, and the MySQL feature-comment no-op control. Native observations and internal companion projections are separate evidence layers; this manifest is not a passing-result claim.
